articles.title: Trump Renews Designation of Nicaragua as an ‘Extraordinary Threat’
articles.description: On November 3, President Trump signed an executive order declaring a “national emergency.” The “emergency” is due to “the unusual and extraordinary threat to the national security and foreign policy of the United States constituted by the situation in Nicaragua.” Supposedly, this emergency began in November 2018, has persisted for eight years and is expected […]
